name: Withy Ring
shortDescription: A woven ring the basket camp wears instead of a password.
examineDescription: A ring the width of your finger, woven from three split withies and finished with a splice rather than a knot. The splice is the whole point: anybody can knot a withy, and only somebody taught in that camp can splice one this way. It is not jewellery and it is not magic. It is a name badge for people who do not write their names down.
examineRider: They are wearing a spliced withy ring on one paw, the sort the basket camp hands out to its own.
